source_chart_type.label: Davison Relationship Chart (Time/Space Midpoint)
source_chart_type.time_basis: Static (midpoint in time and space between two births)
source_chart_type.reference_frame: Geocentric, Tropical (or Sidereal) chart cast for the relationship's mid-time and mid-place
source_chart_type.core_purpose: Creates a chart for the relationship itself by taking the exact midpoint in time and space between two birth charts, yielding an actual date, time, and location that represents the 'birthday' of the relationship. Unlike the midpoint composite, the Davison chart is grounded in real astronomical positions.

calculation_method.mid_time: Average the Julian Day Numbers (or dates and times) of both births to obtain the exact mid-time; this becomes the Davison chart's birth date and time.
calculation_method.mid_space: Average the geographic latitudes and longitudes of both birthplaces to obtain the mid-location; this becomes the Davison chart's birthplace.
calculation_method.chart_casting: Cast a standard natal chart for this derived date, time, and place, producing real planetary positions and angles—not averaged zodiacal midpoints.
calculation_method.time_space_chart: Because it is anchored in real time and space, the Davison is often called a 'time/space chart' and can be timed via transits, progressions, and directions exactly as a natal chart is.

interpretive_focus.relationship_entity: Represents the relationship as an independent being with its own Sun, Moon, angles, and houses, describing its purpose, character, and challenges.
interpretive_focus.purpose_and_destiny: Davison Sun, MC, nodal axis, and outer planets articulate the overarching purpose and destiny trajectory of the bond.
interpretive_focus.emotional_core: Davison Moon and its aspects describe the emotional tone, shared needs, and instinctive responses within the relationship.
interpretive_focus.strengths_and_challenges: Conjunctions, trines, and sextiles show ease and shared goals; squares and oppositions reveal friction and growth edges the relationship is fated to work through.
interpretive_focus.difference_from_composite: Unlike midpoint composites, the Davison chart is anchored to a real-world moment; transit and progression timing against the Davison tends to be more concrete and event-correlated.

baseline_reading: Read Davison as a natal chart: Ascendant, MC, Sun, Moon, then inner and outer planets by sign, house, and aspect.
Focus on angular planets and stellia for dominant relationship themes.
Pay special attention to Saturn, nodes, and outer planets for karmic and long-term lessons.

timing_use.transits: Apply transits to the Davison chart as if it were a natal; Saturn return to Davison Saturn marks major tests and restructuring of the relationship.
timing_use.progressions: Progress the Davison chart (especially Sun, Moon, and angles) to track developmental phases; Davison Sun changing signs correlates with shifts in relationship identity.
timing_use.directions: Solar Arc and primary directions to Davison angles and key planets time critical turning points (start, end, moves, marriages, crises).

comparison_with_other_methods.with_synastry: Use synastry to understand mutual experience and triggers, then Davison for the shared path and purpose.
comparison_with_other_methods.with_composite: Composite describes an abstract midpoint energy field; Davison expresses the relationship's concrete incarnation in time and space. Use both for abstract versus grounded facets.

role_in_relationship_dynamics.function: Gives a grounded, event-sensitive map of the relationship's destiny, showing why it exists, what it must face, and how it evolves over time.
usage: Clarify the long-term purpose of a significant bond (romantic, parent–child, business partnership).
Track Davison transits and progressions around milestone events to understand the relationship's developmental story.
Compare Davison Moon, Venus, and angles with each partner's natal chart to see how each person connects to the relationship's needs and direction.

source_chart_type.label: Progressed Davison Relationship Chart
source_chart_type.relationship_scope: Evolutionary Phases of the Relationship Entity
source_chart_type.time_basis: Dynamic (secondary-style progressions applied to the Davison chart)
source_chart_type.reference_frame: Geocentric, Tropical or Sidereal, secondary progressions
source_chart_type.core_purpose: Applies secondary progressions to the Davison relationship chart, treating it exactly like a natal, to track the relationship's own internal developmental phases and emotional evolution over time.

calculation_method.progression_key: Standard secondary progression key: 1 day after Davison birth date ≈ 1 year of relationship life.
calculation_method.planets_and_angles: Progress all Davison planets and angles; prioritise Sun, Moon, and Asc/MC for major phase shifts.
calculation_method.start_point: Base date is the Davison 'birth date' derived from the time/space midpoints of both natal charts.

interpretive_focus.phase_changes: Progressed Davison Sun and angles changing signs or houses indicate new chapters in the relationship's identity and focus.
interpretive_focus.emotional_cycles: Progressed Davison Moon shows shorter (~2.5-year) emotional cycles, mood shifts, and fluctuations in closeness versus distance within the relationship.
interpretive_focus.aspect_formation: New progressed aspects between Davison planets or to Davison angles mark periods when specific dynamics intensify or resolve.

interpretation_guidelines.hierarchy: Read progressed Davison in tandem with transits and Solar Arc to the base Davison; clusters around the same factors are most significant.
interpretation_guidelines.focus: Prioritise progressed Sun, Moon, and angles; treat slower progressed planets as secondary refinements.
interpretation_guidelines.event_correlation: Back-test key past events (start, cohabitation, marriage, separations) against progressed Davison hits to calibrate orbs.

role_in_relationship_dynamics.function: Maps the internal maturation of the relationship entity across years, independent of individual personal growth.
usage: Explains why the same relationship may feel like a fundamentally different relationship in different periods.
Identifies years when relationship identity, goals, or level of commitment is likely to change.

records.raw_text: Directs the Davison relationship chart by Solar Arc (approximately 1° per year of relationship) to time visible external milestones and crises in the life of the relationship.

source_chart_type.label: Solar Arc Davison Directions
source_chart_type.relationship_scope: Major External Turning Points in the Relationship
source_chart_type.time_basis: Dynamic (Solar Arc directions of all Davison chart positions)
source_chart_type.reference_frame: Geocentric, Solar Arc directions applied to Davison natal positions
source_chart_type.core_purpose: Directs the Davison relationship chart by Solar Arc (approximately 1° per year of relationship) to time visible external milestones and crises in the life of the relationship.

calculation_method.solar_arc_key: Move all Davison planets and angles by a uniform arc equal to the Davison Sun's annual motion (~1° per year).
calculation_method.directions_to_natal: Interpret directed Davison planets and angles contacting base Davison planets and angles.
calculation_method.calendar_mapping: Map arc years from the Davison birth date to real calendar years to identify the timing window.

interpretive_focus.angular_hits: Solar Arc Davison Asc or MC contacting Davison or partner natal planets describes public and status shifts (marriage, moving in, separation, public crises).
interpretive_focus.relationship_planets: Directions involving Davison Sun, Moon, Venus, Mars, and Saturn strongly correlate with relationship turning points.
interpretive_focus.stacking: When Solar Arc Davison contacts coincide with progressed Davison and transits, events are most likely to be concrete and visible.

interpretation_guidelines.event_focus: Use primarily for visible outer events rather than subtle psychological shifts.
interpretation_guidelines.orbs: Operate with tight orbs (~1°) for directed contacts to Davison angles and key planets.
interpretation_guidelines.validation: Back-test major relationship events to tune the arc key and confirm interpretive relevance.

role_in_relationship_dynamics.function: High-level timing tool for major relationship milestones using the Davison entity chart.
usage: Identify windows for formalisation (engagement, marriage), major relocations, or significant crises.
Combine with progressed Davison and transits to triangulate timing windows.

source_chart_type.label: Davison + Natals Overlay
source_chart_type.relationship_scope: How Each Partner Relates to the Relationship Entity
source_chart_type.time_basis: Static (biwheel overlay); Dynamic when timing is applied
source_chart_type.reference_frame: Geocentric, Tropical biwheel (Davison inner wheel + individual natal outer wheel)
source_chart_type.core_purpose: Overlays each partner's natal chart with the Davison relationship chart to show how each individual resonates with, fits, and experiences the relationship entity they have created together.

calculation_method.biwheel_setup: Place Davison chart as inner wheel and one partner's natal as outer wheel; compute inter-wheel aspects and house overlays. Repeat with the second partner.
calculation_method.role_analysis: Identify where each partner's planets fall in Davison houses and how they aspect Davison planets and angles.

interpretive_focus.fit_and_role: Shows how comfortably each person fits the relationship's needs and direction (e.g., natal Sun on Davison Asc vs natal Saturn squaring Davison Venus).
interpretive_focus.asymmetric_experience: Highlights if one partner is more naturally in tune with the relationship entity or carries a disproportionate share of its challenges.
interpretive_focus.activation_points: Partner's natal planets on Davison angles or luminaries mark where they most strongly activate the relationship's fate and storyline.

interpretation_guidelines.partner_by_partner: Read each partner's overlay separately to avoid conflating their roles.
interpretation_guidelines.house_emphasis: Note which Davison houses receive each partner's planets; these are the life areas they contribute to most strongly.
interpretation_guidelines.timing_extension: Use individual transits and progressions to planets tightly aspecting Davison factors as timing triggers for that person's role in relationship evolution.

role_in_relationship_dynamics.function: Explains why each partner experiences the same relationship differently and where they support or strain the relationship entity.
usage: In counselling, show that some tensions originate from mismatch between individual and relationship purpose, not only between partners.
Identify which partner is more likely to initiate changes implied by Davison progressions or transits.
